about: Councils whose own playground lists have been checked. The coverage check (scripts/find-gaps.mjs) only fills gaps from OpenStreetMap in districts listed here, so council sources always come first. Add a district once you've worked through docs/finding-playgrounds.md for it. 'district' must match the local authority name used by postcodes.io (ONS). 'feed' (optional) lets the coverage check read the council's list itself and add new council-listed playgrounds as verified: type 'directory' (index pages, a regex for record links, and regexes for the name and coordinates on each record page, plus optional 'require', a regex a record page must match, and 'approximate': true when the coordinates are the park's rather than the play area's), or 'geojson' / 'csv' (url, name field, and lat/lng fields, plus optional 'sizeField', a field giving the council's size grade). A 'list' feed's CSV can have a 'size' column too; otherwise sizes are read from Fields in Trust grades (LAP, LEAP, NEAP) in its text. Which councils publish sizes is recorded in src/data/size-sources.json.
